{{Top|leg}}
'''Seaflower''' was an underwater [[Species/Legends|species]] of predatory flora on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. They used their shimmering red and blue [[Color/Legends|colors]] to lure small prey creatures within range, then rapidly contracted their petals to swallow their prey whole.
